title: Good Deeds and a Garden University
excerpt: A chance encounter on the bus led me to chase down a German tourist and return his forgotten umbrella — the perfect start to a day exploring NUS, the greenest campus I'd ever set foot on.

photos.alt: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf café storefront inside a modern building, with warm interior lighting and a few patrons seated inside.
An orange NUS campus bus passing through lush green hillside vegetation, viewed from a covered walkway with hanging vines in the foreground.
A black bowl of Thai Mango Fish Rice topped with crushed peanuts, fried fish, lettuce, and jackfruit, served with a fork and spoon on a tray.
